scope: Focused primary-source survey, NOT an exhaustive full-paper systematic review. No external benchmark reproduction in this delivery.

sources.title: LC-Rec: Adapting Large Language Models by Integrating Collaborative Semantics for Recommendation
sources.note: 多角色索引/语言/偏好对齐；部分监督是生成标签。原模型不能与迁移Qwen混称严格复现。

sources.title: MiniOneRec: An Open-Source Framework for Scaling Generative Recommendation
sources.note: 公开SID→SFT→RL框架；本轮不复现其完整训练与结果。

sources.title: Aligning Large Language Models for Controllable Recommendations / RecLM-gen
sources.note: 推荐与条件控制；冻结动态生成器，区别teacher监督和观测真值。

sources.title: Recommendation as Language Processing (RLP): A Unified Pretrain, Personalized Prompt & Predict Paradigm (P5)
sources.note: 推荐相关任务统一文本框架；encoder-decoder不能直接用本包causal loss。

sources.title: OpenP5 official repository
sources.note: T5/LLaMA开发环境；公开主要两类推荐任务，不自动等于P5所有任务。

sources.title: Amazon Reviews 2023 dataset
sources.note: 规模丰富、有文本/时间戳；评论不是完整曝光，历史可用性需核验。

sources.title: KuaiSAR: A Unified Search And Recommendation Dataset
sources.note: 共享用户搜索/推荐；关键词及caption匿名，部分标签有条件定义。

sources.title: KuaiRand dataset
sources.note: 含随机曝光部分和多种反馈；不将缺失反馈直接转负例。

sources.title: Data-efficient Fine-tuning for LLM-based Recommendation (DEALRec)
sources.note: 推荐SFT的数据选择，代理影响力与学习难度；需要正式复现。

sources.title: GORACS: Group-level Optimal Transport-guided Coreset Selection for LLM-based Recommender Systems
sources.note: 组级与OT/梯度选择已有研究；组结构不是我们的独占新颖性。

sources.title: LESS: Selecting Influential Data for Targeted Instruction Tuning
sources.note: 低秩梯度、目标导向选择；简单cosine不可冒充LESS。

sources.title: GRAD-MATCH: Gradient Matching based Data Subset Selection for Efficient Deep Model Training
sources.note: 梯度匹配与OMP已有框架；不把实现OMP当新贡献。

sources.title: A Data-Centric Multi-Objective Learning Framework for Responsible Recommendation Systems (MoRec)
sources.note: 数据驱动多目标推荐已有方法；来源配比需要强对照。

sources.title: Rethinking Data Mixing from the Perspective of Large Language Models (DoGraph)
sources.note: 从梯度角度讨论domain和mixing；不能称首次从模型结构定义数据单元。

sources.title: Filter-then-Weight: Online Data Selection and Reweighting for LLM Fine-Tuning
sources.note: 优化器感知在线更新匹配；本轮保持离线定位，不偷换问题。

sources.title: MiniRec: Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Recommendation
sources.note: RL的reward/gradient/diversity选择；不是现阶段SFT直接结果。

sources.title: Gradient Atoms: Unsupervised Discovery, Attribution and Steering of Model Behaviors via Sparse Decomposition of Training Gradients
sources.note: 共享更新方向稀疏分解已有研究；PDF简化signed-hash方案不是全文所有实现。

sources.title: Beyond neural scaling laws: beating power law scaling via data pruning
sources.note: 裁剪与数据规模区域已有先例；不同任务的成功不能直接外推推荐。

sources.title: Scaling Data-Constrained Language Models
sources.note: 数据受限时重复和算力分配值得研究；不能直接给推荐万能保留率。

sources.title: SemDeDup: Data-efficient learning at web-scale through semantic deduplication
sources.note: 语义近重复对照；文本相似不等于监督作用相同。

sources.title: D4: Improving LLM Pretraining via Document De-Duplication and Diversification
sources.note: 去重＋多样化已有研究；不能把这两个词的组合当新颖性。

sources.title: Qwen3-1.7B official model card
sources.note: 一个可用因果LM骨干；不声称当前最强推荐模型。

sources.title: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct official model card
sources.note: 跨家族验证；本地权重与授权由用户准备。

sources.title: Recommender Systems with Generative Retrieval (TIGER)
sources.note: 生成式检索并不自动等于大规模语言预训练。

sources.title: Self-Attentive Sequential Recommendation (SASRec)
sources.note: 传统序列推荐强对照；teacher与独立评测的职责需分开。

sources.title: Nemotron-CLIMB: CLustering-based Iterative Data Mixture Bootstrapping
sources.note: Semantic learned domains + proxy mixture search; learned domain itself is not novel.

sources.title: Optimizing Pre-Training Data Mixtures with Mixtures of Data Expert Models
sources.note: Domain experts provide structured features for predicting mixture loss.

sources.title: AutoMixAlign: Adaptive Data Mixing for Multi-Task Preference Optimization in LLMs
sources.note: Specialist losses define task gaps; adaptive reweighting/resampling prioritizes weak tasks.

sources.title: Data Mixing Can Induce Phase Transitions in Knowledge Acquisition
sources.note: Controlled evidence that knowledge acquisition can change non-smoothly with model size and mixing ratio.

sources.title: Dynamic Data Mixing Maximizes Instruction Tuning for Mixture-of-Experts
sources.note: Redundancy-aware dynamic data mixture under limited training budget for MoE instruction tuning.

sources.title: Sketching the Readout of Large Language Models for Scalable Data Attribution and Valuation
sources.note: Readout-focused sketching is a strong compute-scalability alternative to full per-example gradients.

user_source.distribution: PDF itself is not included in public code package

repos.action: read only; additive package for user push
